KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. mato
   C. watoto
   D. kitoto

2. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. pana
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. fupi

3. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

4. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Anga.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Anga.

5. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.

7. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

8. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   B. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.
   C. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

9. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Huyo na Hao and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Anga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. C — watoto

2. D — fupi

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

4. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

5. D — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

6. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

7. A — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

8. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

9. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.

12. (4 marks)
